S.FORM: E atu U nikalpacaw 俄烏戰爭 2014 a mihcaan namalpacaw nadikudan sa , aydaay a cung-tung- nu U-kelan wiy-ke-tu. ya-nu-ke-wiy-ci paalesen nu katuuday . 2014 .cay katenes , Elu-se micumud hamin han ni ke-li-mi-ya , tayda itini i tun-pa a kitidaan pacangday tu silusiday a hitay u calilaway , 不久後, ,imahini palekal tu ci lu-kan-se-ke a zen-min- pulung a kanatal , tun-nay-ce-ke pulung a kanatal tusa malaliyas ku sapikuwan .ya tun-pa malingatu a malpacaw . .2014 a mihcaan katukuh 2022 a mihcaan , u adidiay a sinilusiday a hitay masasuada matulin ayda .2014 .namakay 2021 a mihcaan 3 a bulad , E a hitay kina tusa a mibakuhac tu U-kelan nu lilis misa tabaki a mibakuhac masaupu amin ku hitay i tini , mikiayaw itini I lilis nu E atu U nu lilis .自2021年3月起, .2022 a mihcaan 2 abulad 21 a demiad , u E-le-se pangiha palutatenga u tun-ney-ce-ke a kanatal , lu-kan-se-ke a kanatal u E a hitay micumud i tun-pa-se. 2022年2月21日, .2022 a mihcaan 2 a bulad 24 a demiad , ci Bu-ting pangiha a malingatu " micidekay a nu hitay a kawaw" u hitay namakay sepat a dadan namakay amis, timula, amisan, nuwalian nu amis sepat ku caculilan u hamin micumud i U-ke-lan , kyu imahini macunus ku nipalekal tu sakalepacaw .2022年2月24日, . Lu abulad , E a hitay ci ci-hu mibakuhac tu U a hitay paculiyan , mapuut ku hitay nu E a hitay namakay U-kelan a tadikud . 3月起, .9 ay abulad , E-lu-se kinacacay aca pangiha tu sapihaminay muwala tu Utung sepat a kitidaan a pala'. 9月, .U a hitay 2022 a mihcaan masiku kina tusa mibakuhac a paculi , maala nu heni ku hal-ke-hu, hel-sung a tusaay a pala . 烏軍在2022 .nadikudan ani kalpacaw sa matenes matatengteng ku ni kalpacaw . . U nudikuda 背景 u sakalpacaw yadah kukamu nu binawlan , padu E-le-se maydih I nuayawan nu su-lin a kitidaan muliyaw malingatu , ,u E-lu-se paayaw tunu mukasi , u sulin malakalak nadikudan U-ke-lan itini paayaw amin tu U-ke-lan , makayi tu E-ley-se a sapikuwan , ,itini capiay u E-lu-se a binacadan palutatenga amin ku binacadan makayi a buliyasan , ,u amisay a misaahebal kyu u Eluse inayay ku lihalay ." .u mikuwanay a tademaw ci paw-lu. ta-ni-ay-li sakamu sa , sakamu sa ku Eluse sisikining tu sulin a kanatal mikawa micalilaw , ,maydih kuheni muliyaw a mipulu; tu Ukelan ; imahini sakay binacadan tu Ukelan sipakayni mikuwanay u sakala ada kumahidaay .u duma sa i u-cu u sakalihalay a kitidaan , u Eluse ya nuamisan a nikasasusakamu u miadaay sa , ,u duma a kanatal u u-cu makaala tu sakalihalay a patucek sapipulu tu Eluse ani pisatabaki tu nidatengan . .
